text: Server: smaller review findings (missing row_id, list tombstones, roster joins, comments)

Landed. row_id on both nameless-create refusals; a client-pushed lists.deleted that wins LWW now cascades to tombstone the list's live items, matching the invariant housekeeping checks; both roster queries LEFT JOIN account_settings like sync._rosters; the gc.py six-weeks comment. The unbounded IN() expansion was deliberately left — self-inflicted, threshold unverified, and chunking three call sites is more risk than the edge case is worth.
